notes.title: Seeds of Friendship - Available Now On Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Seeds of Friendship is a farming and life sim taking inspiration from the Sixth Generation console game Harvest Moon : A Wonderful Life, and the hidden gem Chulip.

Build your dream farm, restore an animal sanctuary, make new friends and more!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/seedsoffriendship/seeds-of-friendship-a-wonderfully-joyful-farming-life-sim?ref=user_menu

notes.title: Challenge Mode Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Challenge Mode is available now.

Challenge mode is 12 extra hard levels divided into three sets of four. Completing one of these sets will unlock a new character for you to play as in both single, and multiplayer!

GoldenBoy - The protagonist with a shiny new set of red cloths and gold skin.
Skeledude - This skeleton pal touts a fresh, albeit destroyed wind blazer.
Duck - A duck... just a duck.

Let me know your thoughts and I'll...
See you guys soon 👍
Adam

notes.title: All DLC Will be FREE, Challenge Mode + Free Expansion Coming > SOON
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today I am announcing that all DLC for this game will be 100% FREE. At the current time I plan to release Challenge Mode and a Free Expansion.

Challenge Mode will be a unique set of extra hard levels, completing these will unlock new playable characters for use in single and multiplayer.

The Free Expansion will be a seasonal themed expansion, currently planning it to be either Summer or Halloween themed.

Content beyond this will be developed dependent upon player interest in the game. 

Let me know your thoughts and I'll...
See you guys soon 👍
Adam

notes.title: [Giveaway] If you cannot afford the game DM me.
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ISUo0mf_xTI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you would really like to play The Narrator is a DICK : Longer, Harder, and Uncut but are unable to purchase the game for any reason I've requested several copies which I will give away to whoever needs one.

Unfortunately there are those who would take advantage of such an offer only to re-sell the keys on third-party websites. For this reason in order to receive a key your account must appear active and in good standing with Steam.

The game is very cheap, so please be kind and do not request a key unless you truly cannot afford the game.

[u]Please Note : I cannot give away the game until it is released.[/u] If you intend to take advantage of this offer please wishlist the game so you remember when it comes out.
